scope: all current and future Powerhouse chats, agents, skills, workflows, schedulers, portal/cockpit runtimes and intelligence producers
problem: Social, search, analytics, external intelligence and portal data could be connected or queryable without all material observations being durably persisted, freshness-checked and reusable by the canonical One Brain learning loop.
root_cause: Provider connectivity, transport success and source-local storage were historically separable from canonical evidence persistence. Missing trigger/reconcile paths could therefore leave configured sources outside shared Powerhouse evidence and learning.
execution_rule: Before using material social/search/analytics/external/portal data, read the source registry and current data-spine health. Reuse the canonical intake. After source writes, require evidence/readback. Never create a source-local learning silo.
prevention: Every new material producer must register in powerhouse_evidence_sources and write through powerhouse_record_source_observation_v1 or an explicitly approved canonical equivalent.
A configured connector, API credential, provider 2xx or transport success never proves persisted evidence.
Native/platform truth remains distinguishable from transport metadata such as Buffer.
Every source must have freshness semantics and watchdog ownership.
Missed writes must be repairable from canonical source tables through idempotent reconciliation.
Portal state must preserve tenant identity, layer, source timestamp and provenance; legacy projection may not overwrite newer canonical-brain truth.
External/provider data must fail closed on provider-level error/status codes.
Skills and agents must inspect current data-spine health before designing a new ingestion or analytics path.
